Family play

Notifications: about your family, your trips, and play reminders like keeping a streak going. Never ads or promotions.

RoadTrip Royale is made for families. Children under 13 may play online only as part of a family group created and managed by a parent or legal guardian, who must give consent first. The parent approves the child in the app, where each part of the consent is shown as a separate card, and then confirms by email. Today one part, Family play, is required; the other parts are not available and nothing is collected for them. Children never see ads, and we never sell a child's information. A parent can review the child's information, delete it, or withdraw consent at any time in the app under Family settings, or by contacting Hammers Tech LLC, 59 Coventry Lane, Trumbull, CT 06611, 203-268-9171, support@roadtriproyale.com.
12.1 Family play (required)

When a parent confirms consent, we collect and store the child's nickname, a cartoon avatar chosen from the app's set, game activity (license plates found, scores, ranks, achievements, and the trips they join), the month and year the child turns 13, an account ID the app creates, when the account was made and last used, and, if notifications are on, a notification token for their device. To keep the app working, we also receive basic device details (phone model, iOS version, and app version) and crash reports. We use this only to run the game: saving the child's progress online and sharing it with their family. Members of the child's family can see the nickname, avatar, and scores, and people on a trip with the child (always family) can see that trip; no other players can. We send the child notifications only about their family, their trips, and play reminders such as keeping a streak going, never promotions. Google (Firebase) stores and processes this information for us, Apple delivers notifications, and the other services we use are listed in section 7. This part is required for a child to be in a family, because a family game can't work without it. A child who isn't in a family can still play on their own device, and their play stays on that device.
12.2 Usage analytics (not available)

We do not collect usage analytics from children. Analytics are turned off whenever a child is signed in. This option is not available. If we ever offer it, we will update this section and ask a parent or guardian who is a captain of the child's family first; it would stay off unless they agree.
12.3 Ads made for kids (not available)

Children never see ads in RoadTrip Royale, and we do not use a child's information for advertising. This option is not available. If we ever offer it, we will update this section and ask a parent or guardian who is a captain of the child's family first; it would stay off unless they agree.
12.4 Location shared with family (not available)

We do not collect a child's location. Location features are turned off for every child account. This option is not available. If we ever offer it, we will update this section and ask a parent or guardian who is a captain of the child's family first; it would stay off unless they agree.
12.5 Seen by other families (not available)

A child's nickname, avatar, and game activity are visible only to members of their own family. Children can't be found by search, can't add friends, and can't be contacted by players outside their family; there is no chat or messaging. This option is not available. If we ever offer it, we will update this section and ask a parent or guardian who is a captain of the child's family first; it would stay off unless they agree.
